coaching.headline: We converted six of eight won fights into prizes and closed despite three lanes reading unfavored.
coaching.team: The draft read unfavored on paper in three of five lanes -- carry, midlane and jungle -- with only the offlane reading favorably against Greystone. Lt. Belica opened first blood on Iggy & Scorch at 2.3. The skirmish at 6.8 went to them 0-2, flagged a bad trade, followed by a fight lost 2-3 at 9.1 in our half. From 16.3 on we started converting, taking their Outer Tower and then Fangtooth at 17.9. We fought that Fangtooth a body down after Murdock caught Wukong alone at 17.5, and still won 3-0. The costliest sequence of the night came at 21.3: a 2-4 loss left four of five of us dead and cost both our Inner and Outer Tower inside a minute, the single highest-significance fight in the match. From there we won every fight but one, trading a win at 26.2 for their Orb Prime across the map, and closed it out through Fangtooth, Orb Prime and Primal Fangtooth captures into their base. We finished with a 33-to-17 lead in majors and a lopsided 123,676-to-41,865 edge in objective damage, yet towers finished 8 to 9 -- they actually took one more of ours than we took of theirs, which is why a game this one-sided still ran 44 minutes.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Three lanes read unfavored -- carry, midlane and jungle -- yet Legion, Lt. Belica and Wukong combined for 30 kills and carried the game anyway, converting six of eight won fights into towers or neutral objectives.
coaching.whatWorked: We converted six of eight won fights into a prize within ninety seconds, while they cashed just one of their three.

loadout.text: Empowered Cindara leaves behind a rupture that erupts after 0.5s. The eruption deals 20 (+4 per Level) (+25%) Damage to Enemies and Slows by 40% for 1.25s.
loadout.plain: When an outer-edge Ashen Vow hit empowers your next Cindara, that lantern slam also leaves a rupture that erupts and slows. It gives your Ashen Vow into Cindara combo a second hit and makes it hard to walk out of.

loadout.name: Knell
loadout.text: Attacks and abilities against Enemy Heroes apply a stack of Rust for 5s. Each stack shreds 2% (+0.2% per Level) Physical Armor and Magical Armor, stacking up to 4 times. Gain 75% of the Armors shredded.
loadout.plain: Every Cindara swing and ability on a hero adds Rust, cutting their armor and adding some to yours. Your fast stab and slam combos hit max Rust quickly, so longer trades against bruisers and tanks swing your way.

loadout.name: Patina
loadout.text: Gain a 30 (+14 per level) Shield when not taking damage for 10s. Gain 4% Movement Speed while the shield holds.
loadout.plain: A small shield and some move speed come back after you go untouched for 10s. Mostly a lane and roaming comfort piece; it softens the first poke before you dash in with First Intent.

loadout.name: Peal
loadout.text: Gain 15 Ultimate Ability Haste. Upon casting your ultimate, attacks and abilities apply maximum stacks of Rust for 4s. 20s cooldown.
loadout.plain: Swan Song comes back sooner, and casting it slaps max Rust on whoever you hit next. Your ultimate strike and the follow-up Minueta stabs land on a target with their armor already shredded.

loadout.name: Gravitum
loadout.text: Polarity Blast:  Fire a Projectile of Unstable Energy. Pierces Non-Heroes and has infinite range. Deals 80 (+20%) Damage. Grounds the first Hero hit for 2s.
loadout.plain: A long-range shot that grounds the first hero hit, stopping their dashes and jumps. Land it on a slippery target first so they cannot escape your First Intent and Swan Song follow-up.

copy.text: Aion (Bottomless Vial + Runic Focus): 52.1% in 305 Lt. Belica midlane games, level with the hero's 51.3%; this 3-item core: 61.1% in 126 games, above the 53.3% of that hero-role's cores. Proven this patch: worth copying.

loadout.name: Combat Veteran
loadout.text: Gain +2.5% Movement Speed. Passively gain +0.1-2 Experience each second. Increases with Hero Level.
loadout.plain: Generic: a little movement speed and passive XP that grows with level. Helps Belica reach max ability ranks, where her Innovation bonuses kick in, a bit sooner.

loadout.name: Aion
loadout.text: Casting a spell grants 1 Mana Regeneration for 8s (stacks 5x). Spells also grant gold equal to 6% of damage dealt to Enemy Heroes.
loadout.plain: Each spell cast builds mana regen and spell damage to heroes earns gold. Belica casts Void Bomb often, so this keeps her mana up and pays her for poking.

loadout.name: Bottomless Vial
loadout.text: Killing a River Buff restores a Potion charge and grants +5 Magical Power permanently.
loadout.plain: Taking a river buff refills a potion and permanently adds a little magical power. A small sustain and scaling bonus, nothing Belica-specific.

loadout.name: Runic Focus
loadout.text: Gain 0.2% increased Magical Power per 1% current Mana.
loadout.plain: More magical power while your mana is high. Belica's Void Bomb refunds mana on hits, so landing bombs keeps the bonus up.

loadout.name: Soulbearer
loadout.text: Anima:  Gain a 100 (+35) (+6%) Shield for 8s. Gain 20% Magical Lifesteal and 10% Movement Speed for 8s.
loadout.plain: A shield, magical lifesteal and speed for 8s. Pop it before casting Void Bomb and Seismic Assault into a fight to heal off the burst.
